subject: [PATCH v5 06/11] mm, swap: write back vswap zswap entries to physical swap

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch adds support for writing back zswap-backed vswap entries to physical swap. It mirrors the existing zswap writeback path, but allocates the backing physical slot on demand at writeback time rather than pre-allocating it. The zswap shrinker no longer skips vswap entries unless there is no available physical swap space. The patch modifies the zswap_writeback_entry function to handle vswap entries by allocating physical backing before decompressing and storing the entry in the vtable.
